recovery_sequence.initial_failure: boot loop before app_main because the configured 64 KiB internal DMA reserve could not be allocated
recovery_sequence.memory_fix: all libp4_quake.a BSS/common state moved to external PSRAM and locked by the build verifier
recovery_sequence.interrupted_write: one corrected app write lost the USB serial device at 94 percent; the owner reconnected it and the next guarded write completed
recovery_sequence.storage_failure_after_memory_fix: SDMMC send_op_cond timeout before card identification
recovery_sequence.storage_root_cause: the Waveshare socket requires ESP32-P4 on-chip LDO channel 4, as shown by official vendor commit 74d1a8117ea1be5b3edd0e03999d750fb59a2a4f
recovery_sequence.storage_fix: platform_storage now creates, attaches, and releases the board-specific SD power-control handle

classification.firmware: hardware-tested for install, boot, display/touch counters, and launcher stability
classification.sd: hardware-tested for powered read-only mount and bounded empty Console OS catalog
classification.quake: not hardware-tested because the exact PAK is not present on the card
